scanner_c.notes: Strict Sep 13 Toronto-morning previous-24h scan across the U.S., mainland China/Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Europe. Technology and U.S.-equity relevance were prioritized, but macro, energy, policy and finance catalysts were also scanned. Sunday news flow was thin, so only six distinct topics with sufficiently fresh, identifiable and investable catalysts were retained rather than padding to ten. Reuters and the Financial Times were preferred where available.

items.entity: Strait of Hormuz / global oil shipping
items.event_title: Fresh vessel attack near Strait of Hormuz renews oil-supply fears
items.news_summary: Reuters reported a fresh projectile strike on a vessel near the Strait of Hormuz that caused a fire and forced the crew to evacuate. The incident compounds disruption from the partial closure of the strait and a temporary shutdown of Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline, keeping global oil-supply and inflation risk elevated.
items.investor_materiality: Very high: renewed disruption at a critical oil chokepoint can move crude, inflation expectations, Treasury yields, airlines, transports, consumer stocks and energy equities at the same time.
items.selection_reason: The strongest fresh cross-asset catalyst in the window, with a direct path from geopolitics to oil, inflation and U.S. equity valuation.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters citing maritime authorities and regional developments; tactical details may continue to evolve rapidly.
items.video_angle: 霍尔木兹海峡又出事，油价真正危险的地方不是涨到100美元，而是它怎么重新把美国通胀和加息预期一起推高。

items.event_title: Sam Altman says OpenAI will not pursue a 2026 IPO
items.news_summary: Reuters reported that Sam Altman said OpenAI will not go public in 2026, arguing that the current AI-safety environment makes an IPO ill-advised. The statement removes a near-term mega-IPO catalyst while highlighting the tension between frontier-AI capital needs, governance and safety obligations.
items.investor_materiality: Very high for AI capital markets: OpenAI is one of the largest private buyers of compute and a major strategic counterparty for Nvidia, Microsoft, Oracle and data-center suppliers.
items.selection_reason: A fresh, explicit change to expectations around one of the most anticipated potential technology IPOs, with read-through to AI financing and infrastructure partners.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters reporting direct comments from Sam Altman; no replacement IPO date was committed.
items.video_angle: OpenAI突然明确2026年不上市，这对英伟达、微软、Oracle这些给它算力和资本的公司意味着什么？

items.event_title: Larry Ellison cancels planned sale of up to 50 million Oracle shares
items.news_summary: The Financial Times reported that Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison canceled a plan to sell up to 50 million Oracle shares, worth roughly $7.5 billion at Friday's close, one day after the plan became public. Oracle said no shares were sold under the plan and that Ellison has no other current plans to sell Oracle stock.
items.investor_materiality: High: Ellison remains Oracle's dominant shareholder, and the reversal is a direct insider-sentiment signal while investors are already debating Oracle's AI-capex burden, debt and valuation.
items.selection_reason: A concrete, fresh large-cap corporate event tied directly to ORCL ownership and investor sentiment, not an evergreen insider-trading story.
items.source_quality_note: Financial Times reporting based on Oracle's disclosure; the reason for cancellation was not formally given.
items.youtube_query: Oracle ORCL Larry Ellison share sale cancelled
items.video_angle: Larry Ellison刚计划卖75亿美元Oracle股票又突然取消：这是他觉得ORCL被低估，还是在稳定市场情绪？

items.event_title: Equinix hyperscale data-center plan in South Africa faces planning challenge
items.news_summary: The Financial Times reported that a proposed Equinix hyperscale data-center development near Cape Town faces an appeal over planning treatment, water use and power demand. The dispute could force a fuller resource assessment and highlights infrastructure bottlenecks around global AI and cloud expansion.
items.investor_materiality: High: Equinix is a major U.S.-listed data-center operator, and permitting, grid and water constraints are increasingly material to the pace and returns of hyperscale buildouts.
items.selection_reason: A fresh example of the non-GPU bottlenecks that can constrain AI infrastructure growth, with direct EQIX relevance.
items.source_quality_note: Financial Times reporting based on a planning application and appeal; Equinix disputed that it currently has active development plans at the site.
items.youtube_query: Equinix EQIX Cape Town data center power water
items.video_angle: AI数据中心现在最缺的真不是GPU：Equinix在南非遇到的电力、水和审批问题，可能才是下一阶段瓶颈。

items.event_title: Markets brace for potentially hawkish Fed, BOJ and BOE decisions
items.news_summary: The Financial Times reported that markets are entering a major central-bank week with U.S. rate-hike expectations elevated after stubborn inflation and higher energy prices, while investors also see meaningful odds of a Bank of Japan hike and a more hawkish Bank of England stance.
items.investor_materiality: Very high: simultaneous tightening risk across major central banks affects discount rates, currencies, bond yields and global growth-stock valuations.
items.selection_reason: A fresh weekend setup for the coming week's dominant macro catalyst, with direct implications for U.S. equities and the dollar.
items.source_quality_note: Financial Times market analysis; probability estimates are market-implied and should be refreshed immediately before publication.
items.youtube_query: Fed rate hike Warsh BOJ BOE inflation
items.video_angle: 下周不只是美联储，全球央行可能一起变鹰：如果Fed、BOJ都收紧，科技股最怕什么？

items.event_title: PwC reshapes India operations as AI changes consulting economics
items.news_summary: The Financial Times reported that PwC is restructuring its Indian operations through a new joint venture linking its U.S. and India businesses, including offshore acceleration centers and consulting operations, as AI and global cost competition reshape professional services.
items.investor_materiality: Medium-high: PwC is private, but the restructuring is a concrete signal of how AI is changing labor arbitrage, consulting margins and enterprise-service delivery across the broader software and services ecosystem.
items.selection_reason: A fresh, identifiable AI-driven operating-model change from a major global professional-services firm rather than generic commentary about AI replacing jobs.
items.source_quality_note: Financial Times reporting; the joint venture remains subject to regulatory approval and is expected to close in the first half of 2027.
items.video_angle: AI对软件公司之外的冲击开始落地了：PwC为什么要重组印度业务，咨询行业的商业模式会怎么变？
